name: common_subexpression_elimination
summary: Compute each distinct value once — the same op on the same inputs, however the pipelines were written — and fuse each linear run of ops no other node reads into one node.

name: identity_elimination
summary: Delete no-op operations — a zero pad, a same-dtype cast, a full-frame crop — that preserve their input byte for byte.

name: spatial_window_pushdown
summary: Hoist a spatial window (a crop/ROI) earlier past ops it commutes with, so upstream ops process fewer pixels.

name: cast_chain_collapse
summary: Drop a redundant intermediate cast from a cast chain when the intermediate dtype losslessly holds the input and dropping it keeps the final cast's conversion (a narrowing intermediate quantizes, and a float between an integer input and an integer target saturates, so both are kept).

name: cast_identity
summary: Drop a cast whose target dtype already equals its input dtype.

name: view_flip_involution
summary: Cancel two adjacent flips over the same axes (flip∘flip = id).

name: view_transpose_merge
summary: Merge two adjacent transposes into one (or into the identity).

name: scalar_fusion
summary: Fuse adjacent scalar/compute ops into one kernel (f64 chains stay unfused — a mandatory precision guard, not this toggle).
